467	def _collect_reply(
468	    stream,
469	    prompt: str,
470	    max_tokens: int,
471	    new_detokenizer: Callable[[], Any],
472	) -> ChatGeneration:
473	    """Read one reply from a token stream, stopping at `max_tokens` of answer.
474	
475	    `enable_thinking=False` only works when the model's chat template reads
476	    it. A model that thinks anyway would spend the budget on text that is
477	    stripped from the answer, so thinking tokens are not counted against
478	    `max_tokens`. The caller caps the stream at `max_tokens` plus
479	    `THINKING_HEADROOM_TOKENS`, which bounds the thinking.
480	
481	    `new_detokenizer` returns a fresh streaming detokenizer of the kind the
482	    stream uses. It is needed when the reply is stopped here: see
483	    `_detokenize`.
484	    """
485	    # Some templates end the prompt with an open thinking block, so the
486	    # output starts inside it and carries only the closing tag.
487	    opened_by_prompt = prompt.rstrip().endswith("<think>")
488	    prefix = "<think>" if opened_by_prompt else ""
489	    thinking = _ThinkingTracker(inside=opened_by_prompt)
490	    segments: list[str] = []
491	    tokens: list[Any] = []
492	    prompt_tokens = generated = reasoning_tokens = 0
493	    # Tokens whose text may be the start of a thinking tag split across
494	    # segments: charged to neither budget until the tag is complete or ruled out.
495	    pending = 0
496	    finish_reason = None
497	    stopped_here = False
498	
499	    with closing(stream):
500	        for response in stream:
501	            if getattr(response, "is_draft", False):
502	                continue
503	            segments.append(response.text)
504	            step = response.generation_tokens - generated
505	            generated = response.generation_tokens
506	            prompt_tokens = response.prompt_tokens
507	            finish_reason = response.finish_reason
508	            if thinking.feed(response.text):
509	                reasoning_tokens += step + pending
510	                pending = 0
511	            elif thinking.partial_tag:
512	                pending += step
513	            else:
514	                # Not a tag after all: the held tokens were answer text.
515	                pending = 0
516	            if finish_reason is not None:
517	                # The stream's last response: it has flushed its text.
518	                break
519	            tokens.append(response.token)
520	            excess = generated - reasoning_tokens - pending - max_tokens
521	            if excess >= 0:
522	                # Held tokens that turned out to be answer text are all
523	                # counted at once and can pass the cap: drop the extra ones.
524	                if excess:
525	                    del tokens[-excess:]
526	                    generated -= excess
527	                stopped_here = True
528	                finish_reason = "length"
529	                break

541	def _detokenize(detokenizer, tokens: list[Any]) -> str:
542	    """The full text of `tokens`.
543	
544	    A streaming detokenizer can hold back the text of the newest tokens (an
545	    unfinished word or UTF-8 sequence) until a later token or the end of the
546	    stream. A stream that is closed early never flushes that text, so its
547	    segments can be short of the tokens it generated.
548	    """
549	    detokenizer.reset()
550	    for token in tokens:
551	        detokenizer.add_token(token)
552	    detokenizer.finalize()
553	    return detokenizer.text
554

556	# Opening tag of a thinking block -> the tag that closes it. Gemma 4 emits
557	# its channel tokens in either order (see `_strip_gemma_channel_blocks`).
558	_THINKING_TAGS = {
559	    "<think>": "</think>",
560	    "<|channel>": "<channel|>",
561	    "<channel|>": "<|channel>",
562	}
563	_LONGEST_THINKING_TAG = max(len(tag) for pair in _THINKING_TAGS.items() for tag in pair)
564	
565	
566	class _ThinkingTracker:
567	    """Tells, segment by segment, whether a stream is inside a thinking block.
568	
569	    Looks only at each new segment plus a few carried characters (a tag can
570	    be split across segments), so the work per token does not grow with the
571	    length of the reply.
572	    """
573	
574	    def __init__(self, inside: bool = False) -> None:
575	        self._closing_tag = "</think>" if inside else None
576	        self._carry = ""
577	
578	    def feed(self, segment: str) -> bool:
579	        """Add a segment; True if any of it belongs to a thinking block."""
580	        text = self._carry + segment
581	        thinking = self._closing_tag is not None
582	        pos = 0
583	        while True:
584	            if self._closing_tag is None:
585	                found = [
586	                    (at, tag)
587	                    for tag in _THINKING_TAGS
588	                    if (at := text.find(tag, pos)) != -1
589	                ]
590	                if not found:
591	                    break
592	                at, tag = min(found)
593	                self._closing_tag = _THINKING_TAGS[tag]
594	                pos = at + len(tag)
595	                thinking = True
596	            else:
597	                at = text.find(self._closing_tag, pos)
598	                if at == -1:
599	                    break
600	                pos = at + len(self._closing_tag)
601	                self._closing_tag = None
602	        # Keep only what could still be the start of a tag.
603	        self._carry = text[pos:][-(_LONGEST_THINKING_TAG - 1) :]
604	        return thinking
605	
606	    @property
607	    def partial_tag(self) -> bool:
608	        """True if the stream, outside a thinking block, ends with the start
609	        of an opening tag (e.g. `<th`), so its last tokens can't be classified
610	        yet."""
611	        if self._closing_tag is not None:
612	            return False
613	        return any(
614	            self._carry.endswith(tag[:n])
615	            for tag in _THINKING_TAGS
616	            for n in range(1, len(tag))
617	        )
